diagnosis.observed: Each shot passed in-shot identity, but the final evaluator identified three different performers and wardrobe variants across the cut.
diagnosis.rootCause: The commercial orchestrator supplied internal reference_asset_ids, but the Volcengine image-generation protocol serializer discarded that field. Each Seedream first frame was therefore generated from text alone.
diagnosis.testGap: The existing orchestrator test asserted only the pre-serialization Ark submission and never asserted the provider request body.

repair.referenceResolution: Resolve tenant-scoped director references from durable asset storage and include their bytes in the orchestration boundary.
repair.providerContract: Encode the reviewed reference as a bounded data URL in the Volcengine image-generation image field; each video remains bound to its resulting first frame.
repair.failClosed: Missing, non-image, empty, over-10-MiB or out-of-scope references reject before provider contact.
repair.immutability: No cp79 bytes or evidence are modified.
